description:
Mum Pray For Your Son is a deeply personal project which explores themes of childhood, parenthood, marriage and faith. It draws on the sounds of the 90’s rap and hip-hop scene as well as early 2000’s RnB, giving the record a timeless feel and aligning it with the music Oscar listened to growing up.

Having had the title Mum Pray For Your Son in mind since 2017, Oscar #Worldpeace draws on not only his own childhood for the project, but also becoming a parent. He says; ‘In a lot of my older music I couldn’t touch on parenthood yet as it was still new to me. Now I’m 4 years in, its a great time for me to reflect on that in my music and to compare the things I want for my son to how I was raised’. The record opens with Oscar’s son’s voice asking ‘Daddy where’s your bible?’, also highlighting the theme of faith and prayer throughout the project.

Mum Pray For Your Son sees Oscar team up with several other artists including long time collaborator Bawo, Canadian hip-hop trio Planet Giza and singer-songwriter Qendresa. Each guest brings a unique offering to the project and positions Oscar within a rapidly evolving global scene.

‘That’s the premise of Mum Pray For Your Son, its a very personal record but I also have fun on there. I was able to do everything I wasn’t able to do on my other projects, and do it all on one album.’

- Oscar #Worldpeace
credits:
Production by Oscar #Worldpeace, Rami B, IGLU NOISE, Waller and Oscar Jerome.
